name: Cafari
subtitle: Sideload builds of Cafari, the casting browser.
description: Install and update Cafari without going through TestFlight. Builds are signed and hosted on GitHub releases.

apps.name: Cafari
apps.subtitle: A casting browser: web video to Chromecast, AirPlay, or the car screen.
apps.localizedDescription:
Cafari is a browser that sends web video to a Chromecast, an AirPlay receiver, or the car's screen.

Builds expire 90 days after they are made; the app warns for the last two weeks before it stops working, and updating through this source replaces it with a current build.

Casting to Chromecast and AirPlay receivers works with any signing. Video on the car's own CarPlay screen depends on how the build is signed, and re-signing with your own Apple ID may lose it.

versions.localizedDescription: Wireless CarPlay adapters: the picture now holds, stopping returns the car to its own screen, and Cafari casts straight away after joining the adapter's Wi-Fi. Works on iOS 26.4 and later and on iOS 27.0; not yet on the iOS 27.2 beta. Expires 2026-12-20.
